information.title: Consulting and testing services
information.offer: You can be tested anonymously for HIV and sexually transmitted infections, including hepatitis B and C, and receive counselling. You can also ask questions about partnership, contraception or sexual orientation confidentially and anonymously. If necessary, you can be referred to further support services.
information.applies_to: The service is aimed at everyone. The tests can be carried out from the age of 16 without the consent of a parent or guardian.
information.test_results: All test results are only communicated in person.
information.other_services: If you are a sex worker, please use the „Sex work” tab.
information.costs_info: You must pay the costs of the laboratory tests yourself. Adolescents and young adults up to the age of 24 can take an HIV test and a chlamydia test free of charge.
information.notice_info: Your IP address is transmitted to process your booking. The IP address is collected solely for technical purposes.

personal_area.title: Would you like to make an appointment?
personal_area.information: Appointments for consultation and testing can be arranged online. Appointments are always available two weeks in advance.
